svg.title: Who held what, 1345–1450 · artifact custody
svg.desc: Holders and dates from the graph's "holds" edges and the artifact pages. Colour shows whose hands: Kęstutaičiai, Algirdaičiai, wolves and keepers, Henė.

text.tspan: Holders and dates from the graph's "holds" edges and the artifact pages. Colour shows whose hands: Kęstutaičiai, Algirdaičiai, wolves and keepers, Henė.
Kęstutis · received after the Pact, winter 1345–46
cracked; burns with him at Palanga, Mar 1450
Jogaila's stone: a river pebble 1 Jun 1434
Green: Kęstutaičiai · Tan: Algirdaičiai · Gold: wolves, keepers, Rimgailė · Red: Henė · Dashed white: held by no one, or unknown
